summary.intent: Ship the Callisto v1-alpha work packages (F1, F2, then G and M, with H queued) as separate signed PRs. Then address the Entire review findings on #570 and #571, backed by mutation testing, with the lead session directing priorities.
summary.outcome: F1 and F2 merged. G (#571) and M (#570) were opened, gated, and had round-1 findings fixed, pushed, resolved and mutation-tested. Round 2 on #571 was in progress: the provenance approach was dropped for the lead's cheaper plan (add skips archived slugs, apply reports duplicates, PR-link lookup keyed by original path), with edits made but the fix not yet committed, gated or pushed.

repo: Seed/Source in aggregate.rs replaced the severities/reasons/named_by maps. A package's severity is the max over all its sources, and packages with no fresh source are dropped in pre mode.
Gate commands: just pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, and ci. Cargo runs use CARGO_BUILD_JOBS capped at a quarter of the cores and debug info off.
In these worktrees the local branch names differ from the remote ones, so a plain git push does nothing. Push with explicit refspecs (HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>) and verify with git ls-remote.

Commits must be signed (verify via gh api .../commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason), carry no trailers or session links, and must not include mutants.out*. mutants.out.old is tracked on main until #574 merges, so restore it from HEAD after each run.
Archived pre-cycle notes live in .changeset/pre/; archived changeset IDs are now `pre/<stem>`, and archive clashes are named feature-2.md and so on.

Entire trails: `entire trail link <n> --branch ... --base main` can race the push (retry with the idempotency key), then `ci-pr`; findings are handled with `entire trail finding resolve <change> <id>`.

Decision schema is now v3 with a consumedChangesets field, and E165 compares changeset sets (ConsumedChangesetsDiffer). Docs and specs touched: docs/releasing.md, docs/errors.md, docs/specs/*.json, and the ADR 0002.

code.finding: The changeset loader reads only direct-child .md files under the changesets dir. status.rs coverage must match this, otherwise nested files such as .changeset/archive/old.md count as coverage.
A package's reason keeps only the winning source, so inference coverage must be tracked separately (plan.inferred) from the final bump reason.

Reviewer note: the linked-group target uses named_severity, which excludes Group sources. This differs from the old behavior outside pre mode when a fixed group raises a member in the same pass. The effect is unverified.

workflow: Write the regression test first and confirm it fails before the fix. This was done for every review finding.
A mutants timeout can be the detection mechanism for an infinite-loop mutant, such as `n += 1` -> `n *= 1` in archive_slot. Report it explicitly in the PR body.
Stop background jobs before resetting a commit, then restore mutants.out.old and remove mutants.out.
Peer messages from the lead redirected the work mid-task. Cheap, by-design fixes were preferred over new recovery state, and after round 2 further findings go to the lead for triage.

friction: The G mutants run first failed with exit 4 because the filter named a nonexistent test binary (release_preview_tests).
entire trail link raced the branch push and failed with 'branch does not exist' until retried.
The full test suite is slow (1924 tests), and the G subagent kept re-sending the same report until it was stopped.
macOS CI jobs on #571 were cancelled for runner capacity and had to be re-run.
Round-2 provenance work was built and then discarded when the lead changed course, and the mutants/gate run on it was killed.
open_items: Finish round 2 on #571: verify the add-skips-archive and duplicate-note tests pass, add the PR-link lookup test, then commit, run the gates and cargo mutants on the new diff, push, resolve 01M7QYY5ZCF7, and dismiss 01M7QYY5YJ8W with the lead's stated reason.
H is blocked until #571 merges. Then rebase it onto main, re-run the gates, and ship it with the known-limits section.
#577 (S) conflicts with G and will merge main in after G lands.
Known limits: a stale release PR that deletes no changesets evades E165's changeset check, and re-running version before a prerelease tag re-infers the same commits for auto packages.
Reviewer finding 1 (linked-group named_severity) and finding 2 (rerun re-inference) are only partly verified or accepted.
New public surface needing owner sign-off: the status --since flag and the changed-without-changeset diagnostic code.
